code='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator = None
    for r in range(height):
        if grid[r] and grid[r][0] != 0 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and height-r-1 == r:
            separator = ("horizontal", r)
            break
    if separator is None:
        for c in range(width):
            col = [row[c] for row in grid]
            if col[0] != 0 and len(set(col)) == 1 and c > 0 and width-c-1 == c:
                separator = ("vertical", c)
                break
    orientation, index = separator
    if orientation == "horizontal":
        a, b = grid[:index], grid[index+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(a, b)]
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][index+1+c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(index)] for r in range(height)]
